atomic_facts.fact: FTX Trading Ltd is incorporated in Antigua and Barbuda

FTX US acquired LedgerX, a regulated US options exchange, in 2021
LedgerX was sold out of FTX's bankruptcy to MIAX in 2023
As of June 2, 2025, FTX Trading Ltd was not fully licensed to operate in the United States
Sam Bankman-Fried co-founded FTX (founded in 2019 by SBF and Gary Wang)
SBF was sentenced in March 2024 to 25 years in prison
SBF is serving a 25-year prison sentence for defrauding investors and lenders in connection with FTX
As of 2026-10-01, SBF remains incarcerated (behind bars)
SBF could not have led the exchange in 2025
FTX Trading Ltd remained a Chapter 11 debtor as of December 3, 2025
FTX's exchange collapsed in 2022 and is no longer operating (formerly operated)
FTX did not relaunch its exchange worldwide in 2025
